title: Units of measure: review follow-ups of PR #37449 (catalog read failure caching and truncation; unit-name translations outside staleness)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (L1 N4 + N5 of seat repo:objectstack#5 on PR #37449, verdict 7185332286; contract record 7185313489). Follow-up of #35490.

Grading: `area:data` · reach: read — evidence: read, no measured wrong answer.
Suggested-grade: p3 · degraded display only (a missed label or a stale translation), no data change.

## What

- N4: the console's unit-catalog read caches a failure for the whole session, truncates silently at `$top: 2000`, and sends no `$count: false`. Retry a failed read (or cache only success), and either page past 2000 or say so loudly when truncated.
- N5: the `standardUnit<CODE>` entries in the platform-objects translation bundles' `messages` sit outside the translation staleness mechanism, so a later edit of a spec English base name (`STANDARD_UNIT_NAMES`) leaves the ten translations served with no flag. Bring them under the same staleness check as the other generated bundles, or pin the English source hash beside them.

Related: #35490 (PR #37449).
Dedupe: searched open issues for '37449' — none.
